article.summary: AURORA is a local code-aware memory and intelligence layer for coding assistants. The official repository is archived; this review inspected selected documentation and core storage code at the verified main head and ran no system or benchmark.

who_what.text: The official README presents AURORA as a local code-memory and code-intelligence framework for coding assistants. It documents a CLI, MCP/LSP-facing tools, code and Markdown indexing, and SQLite-backed local memory. The reviewed paths do not establish a hosted multi-tenant memory service.

architecture.text: The core package separates chunk types, storage, context, activation, metrics, logging, and resilience. Its example CodeChunk carries an ID, absolute file path, element type, symbol name, and line range; the Store interface saves and retrieves chunks. The inspected in-memory implementation uses separate chunk, activation, and relationship collections.

The documented product indexer parses code into chunks, uses Git and LSP signals, and includes Markdown documents. Persistent storage is SQLite at the documented default path ~/.aurora/memory.db; the inspected SQLite module describes thread-local pooled connections, lazy schema initialization, transactional error rollback, JSON serialization, relationship traversal, and WAL enabled by default. The indexing pipeline was not inspected.

In-memory save validates the chunk and assigns it by ID; new IDs receive an initial activation entry. The in-memory store is documented as a test-oriented backend and explicitly says it is not thread-safe.

behavior.text: Write/update: the package guide demonstrates save_chunk and get_chunk by ID. The selected in-memory save path overwrites the current object at a matching ID and initializes activation state only for a new ID. This selected path shows no separate revision or supersession record; persistent SQLite mutation behavior was not exhaustively traced.

Index and retrieval: the root README documents `aur mem index .` and `aur mem search <query>`. It describes ranking around activation decay and relevance with Git and LSP enrichment. Those are documentation observations; the indexer/retrieval implementation, scoring formula, query filters, and stale-index cleanup were not inspected.

Delete/reset: the inspected in-memory store's reset and close clear its in-memory chunks, activations, and relationships. The selected sources do not establish individual deletion, stale-file cleanup, or durable erasure behavior for the SQLite-backed user-facing index.

Scope: the root README documents a per-project `.aurora/memory.db` path and per-project configuration. This suggests project-local placement, but the reviewed code does not establish authenticated user, tenant, or shared-host isolation.

Provenance/evidence: documented chunk fields include file path and source line range; README examples display Git and LSP-derived context and score explanations. File-location metadata can point back to source, but the selected code does not establish evidence adjudication, mutation audit, or citation-support guarantees.

Source-visible efficiency and observability: SQLite source documents connection pooling, per-thread connections, WAL mode, deferred initialization, transactions, and relationship traversal. The README displays component scores and approximate command speeds as examples; these were not measured in this review.

metrics.evidence: No answerable or unanswerable retrieval probes were run; selected sources do not establish an abstention contract.
No correction or stale-result probes were run; the selected store paths do not establish versioned correction behavior.
No deletion probes were run and durable deletion semantics were not verified in the selected code.
No cross-project probes were run; project-local database placement does not establish an authorization boundary.

metrics.domain: Evidence support precision and citation coverage
metrics.evidence: No output evidence was adjudicated; file and line metadata are not themselves a measurement of support precision.
No timing was collected. README approximate speeds and examples are documentation, not measurements from this review.
No token or cost workload was run.
No storage size or corpus efficiency was measured.

limits.text: This is a bounded review of selected documentation and core store code at the verified archived main head. It did not inspect the complete code/document indexing pipeline, MCP handlers, or full query stack; documented behavior and implementation observations are identified separately.

A local SQLite path does not prove operating-system permissions, authenticated scope enforcement, or safety for a shared-host deployment. Runtime correctness, quality, deletion guarantees, latency, tokens, and storage outcomes remain unverified.
The official repository README was checked for a published contact email and none was present; the review record stores null with the exact checked URL.

benchmark.summary: No AURORA system execution or benchmark was performed. Project metrics, fixture, and status record are protocol references only, not results for AURORA.
